fieldValues.title: The spec language registry names a field that will never exist
fieldValues.summary: check-spec-language's registry references normativeSites.expositionRoles — an exposition_role field on records. The #556 ruling settled that a leaf's Type is its role and no exposition_role field will be introduced, so the registry names a site nothing can ever populate.
evidence: The language registry's normativeSites entry names expositionRoles
The 2026-09-05 ruling on srs#556 (comment 5552715003): tree by contains, order by precedes, prerequisites by depends-on, zero new fields — the leaf's Type is its exposition role
PR #620 records it as a follow-on for srs#569
fieldValues.body: A registry entry pointing at a field that the governing ruling has foreclosed is dead configuration that still reads as a plan. It was left in place rather than removed inside the RFC unit: removing it is a change to a different mechanism (#569's language registry) and belongs in that unit, where the review can see the registry as a whole.
